name: 11377 · Woodside, NY
findings: ZIP 11377 (Woodside) has 192 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11377 (Woodside) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
92% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
